ranked.headline: Learned models score molecular interactions against docking and structure baselines
ranked.summary: Recent benchmarks compare deep learning and hybrid quantum-classical methods with docking and all-atom structure models for binding prediction.

ranked.headline: Computational models link spatial gene expression to tissue architecture and histology
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add standardized spatial statistics, cross-modal registration, and foundation-model histology predictors for spatial gene…

ranked.headline: New models refine genetic association testing across traits, epistasis and omics
ranked.summary: Biobank-scale studies, including a 1.06M-case psychiatric GWAS and an epistasis test, drive demand for joint multivariate and interaction modeling.

ranked.headline: Controlled tests of pretrained biomolecular representations against simpler baselines
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications test whether learned protein, molecule, and single-cell encoders outperform simpler alternatives on defined tasks.

ranked.headline: Explicit models of spatial transcriptomics structure for simulation, QC and embedding
ranked.summary: Spatial omics datasets now reach 100,000+ locations and ~30M cells, driving demand for scalable, spatially aware statistical and learned models.

ranked.headline: Deep representation learning is applied across omics prediction, regulons and cell types
ranked.summary: Language-model embeddings, sequence foundation models and contrastive multimodal frameworks are now being applied to omics and genome data.

ranked.headline: Computational tools for long-read, single-cell and variant analysis in genomics
ranked.summary: Long-read and duplex sequencing now feed isoform, variant, and vector-genome analyses that need faster, benchmarked preprocessing.

ranked.headline: Causal graphs connect regulators, programs and traits via Perturb-seq networks
ranked.summary: Single-cell eQTL mapping and Perturb-seq networks now enable cell state-specific causal inference of gene regulation at scale.

ranked.headline: Simulators and benchmarks now quantify accuracy limits in sequencing variant calling
ranked.summary: Ground-truth simulators and systematic benchmarks now test mapping, methylation, and modification calling on long-read and high-coverage sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Compressed and collision-free k-mer indexing for sequence and ancient DNA analysis
ranked.summary: Large k-mer sets, ancient DNA pangenome alignment, and metagenomic BAM files each require compact storage and validated computation.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks reveal how analytic design choices shape single-cell and omics outcomes
ranked.summary: Systematic comparisons of feature selection, batch correction, coexpression, and pseudobulk methods show how analytic choices change results.

ranked.headline: Graph and sequence learning models predict drug, miRNA and disease associations
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs graph neural networks with SMILES, RNA and text-derived embeddings to improve biomolecular interaction prediction across tasks.

ranked.headline: Frameworks score transcriptomic, regulatory and spatial features against reference sets
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply explicit quantitative scoring to gene sets, RNA editing, miRNA targeting, and spatial ligand-receptor data.

ranked.headline: Genomic identifiers and phylogenomic markers refine bacterial taxonomy and HGT detection
ranked.summary: Hierarchical, threshold-based genomic identifiers and phylogenomic markers are being formalized for bacterial taxonomy and gene transfer detection.

ranked.headline: Long-read and single-cell methods recover chromosome-scale genome architecture
ranked.summary: Long-read and single-cell data now allow chromosome-scale structure and X-chromosome activity to be inferred de novo from sequencing data alone.

ranked.headline: Haplotype-level tools for polyploid phasing, haploblocks and crossover estimation
ranked.summary: Recent software spans polyploid phase uncertainty, haploblock detection, crossover inference and genotyping simulation from SNP and sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Inferring protein conformational ensembles from cryo-EM particles and learned potentials
ranked.summary: Single-structure determination under-reports conformational heterogeneity, motivating ensemble-level inference from particle images and learned potentials.

ranked.headline: Heterogeneous encoders and generative augmentation for peptide immunogenicity prediction
ranked.summary: Protein language models and generative augmentation are now being applied to peptide immunogenicity tasks, with most gains still preprint-stage.

ranked.headline: Synthetic data and foundation models advance automated biomedical image analysis
ranked.summary: Reduced reliance on hand annotation and missing-data handling is making automated cell and behavioral measurement more scalable.

ranked.headline: Protein language models gain interpretability, design tuning, and dynamics readouts
ranked.summary: Protein language models are being probed with sparse autoencoders, fine-tuned on self-generated data, and applied to B-factor decoding.

ranked.headline: Supervised models map molecular profiles to clinical targets with structured inputs
ranked.summary: Recent items apply supervised models with explicit input structure to predict cancer treatment outcomes from multiomic and clinical data.

ranked.headline: Deep representation models integrate multi-omic and longitudinal transcriptomic data
ranked.summary: Preprints and one published study apply autoencoder and self-supervised contrastive designs to sparse, heterogeneous omic and clinical data.

ranked.headline: Structure-conditioned models design DNA and score protein and RNA energetics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints condition sequence design and energy models on explicit 3D backbone or conformational structure rather than sequence alone.

ranked.headline: Complete reference genome assemblies underpin plant genomic and single-nucleus analyses
ranked.summary: Assembly choice and completeness now directly shape single-nucleus mapping, variant scoring and haplotype-resolved structural analysis in plants.

ranked.headline: Open-source packages standardize omics interpretation, annotation, and data handling
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published R/Bioconductor package formalize recurring omics analysis steps as reusable, interoperable software.

ranked.headline: Coupling population, phenotype, and read-level evidence to individual variant calls
ranked.summary: Post-calling refinement of long- and short-read variant sets now combines population frequencies, guideline criteria, and read-level heterozygosity.

ranked.headline: Reference databases and probabilistic models refine metagenomic profiling accuracy
ranked.summary: Expanded microbiome references and coverage-aware profilers target false positives in taxonomic and gene-level profiling of sequencing data.

ranked.headline: Refined force fields and constant-pH sampling improve MD of biomolecular systems
ranked.summary: Recent work flags cation overbinding to phosphates in all-atom force fields and reports GPU-accelerated constant-pH MD in NAMD.

ranked.headline: Simulation-based free energies and residence times for GPCR and drug binding
ranked.summary: Enhanced-sampling and physics-based protocols now aim to predict GPCR activation free energies and absolute drug residence times.

ranked.headline: Stochastic models of mutation, replication and reproductive timing under noisy dynamics
ranked.summary: Stochastic models now connect replication asymmetry, repeat length stability and reproductive timing to noise-driven dynamics.

ranked.headline: Structure-guided design yields active nucleases and epitope-specific antibodies
ranked.summary: Structure-based computational workflows now generate functional nuclease variants and developable antibodies, with experimental screening reported.

ranked.headline: Dynamic models map coexistence and oscillatory extinction in microbial communities
ranked.summary: Recent models resolve when phage-bacteria oscillations go extinct and when small antagonistic communities coexist.

ranked.headline: Resource competition sets weights and thresholds in molecular perceptron circuits
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a hardware p-computer demonstration extend perceptron-like molecular computing to classification, regression, and docking.

ranked.headline: Coarse-grained simulations resolve DEAD-box helicase unwinding and modular architecture
ranked.summary: Coarse-grained and enhanced-sampling simulations now resolve ATP-independent duplex unwinding and modular solution ensembles of DEAD-box proteins.

ranked.headline: Computational tools map protein and lipid localization across subcellular compartments
ranked.summary: Three December 2025 reports introduce semi-supervised and neural network tools for protein localization from organelle profiling data.

ranked.headline: Explicit inference formulations recast single-cell identity, fate, and annotation
ranked.summary: Late-2025 single-cell papers formulate identity, lineage, and annotation tasks as inference problems with explicit assumptions.

ranked.headline: Learned Models Advance Single-Cell, Spatial and Phylogenetic Analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published method report gains in batch correction, spatial denoising and tree inference over existing tools.

ranked.headline: Predicted Structures Tested for Disorder, Amyloid Polymorphs, and Substitution Matrices
ranked.summary: Structure predictors are now benchmarked on disordered and amyloid targets and used to derive substitution matrices, testing where their outputs remain…

ranked.headline: Connectome topology predicts fly visual responses; CNN design recipe decodes EEG and ECoG
ranked.summary: Recent preprints constrain neural response models with anatomical geometry, connectome topology, or explicit design rather than purely phenomenological fitting.

ranked.headline: Standardized workflows and databases for prophage, lysin, and microbial network discovery
ranked.summary: Reusable pipelines for prophage, lysin, and local network analysis are appearing alongside expanded metagenomic discovery resources.
